text:
tara: Noticed onboarding parity gap across sdks: js/py/go have `clientConcurrency` and `prefetch`, but go/csharp used different names. Causing docs confusion and ops surprises during ramp tests.
ben: Can you share an example where this bit us?
tara: During a smoke run we set `concurrency=12` in the go sample (old name). Ops expected the js default semantics (max inflight). Result: effective concurrency soared because `prefetch` still defaulted high -> quota trips.
niko: Ugh. Also found auth-refresh behavior differs: py-sdk has single-flight refresh, js-sdk didn't. That produced a token stampede and lots of 401->429 cascades.
tara: Logs: ```HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
x-rate-limit-limit: 30
x-rate-limit-remaining: 0
x-rate-limit-reset: 6``` Plus `401` bursts just before.
ben: Action items: 1) standardize config names across sdks (clientConcurrency, prefetchPages, retryPolicy). 2) expose `onboardRampMs` env and default to staggered startup. 3) implement single-flight auth refresh in js and csharp. 4) add shared retry helper with exp backoff + decorrelated jitter.
niko: Also suggest SDKs probe `/v1/limits` on init to seed a client-side token-bucket, fall back to safe default (10 rps) if headers missing. This prevents blind blasting.
tara: Agree. For quick mitigation update sample app defaults: `clientConcurrency=6`, `prefetchPages=1`, `onboardRampMs=30000`. Add a flag `--aggressive` for power users.
doris: I'll draft a small RFC and change list for devex docs. Include recommended telemetry: log `x-rate-limit-*` on failures and attach `sdk.config` snapshot to onboarding traces.
ci-bot: CI: lint and unit tests pass for js-sdk PR #512; failing tests in py-sdk PR #513 (auth-lock edge).
ben: Who picks the cross-sdk parity task? I can take coordinating PRs + doc updates. Plan: create a parity-checklist and a tiny integration harness that mocks quota headers and asserts each SDK respects token-bucket.
tara: Great. Also add an inbound dev note: "If you hit quota during onboarding, lower `clientConcurrency` and enable ramping". I'll update onboarding README and add links to the SDK helpers.
niko: I'll add `singleFlightRefresh` to js-sdk and a small integration test that ensures only one refresh happens under churn.
doris: :thumbsup: Let's roll these changes this week; customer onboarding this month depends on smoother ramps.
